errors.deal_wrong_org: This deal belongs to another organization.
errors.equity_wrong_org: This equity position belongs to another organization.
errors.loan_wrong_org: This transaction belongs to neither organization of the current account.
errors.loan_wrong_side: Only the debtor allocates on a current account. On the lender's side, the advance is matched to the borrower's current-account deal.
errors.already_matched_to_deal: This transaction is already matched to a deal. Unmatch it first.
errors.allocated_to_liability: This transaction is allocated to a liability (equity or current account). Detach it from the Liabilities page first.
errors.allocated_to_transfer: This transaction is a leg of an internal transfer. Detach it first.
errors.transfer_wrong_entity: Both accounts do not belong to the same entity: this is not an internal transfer. Point the movement to that entity, like a deal.
errors.transfer_wrong_org: This transaction belongs to another organization.
errors.transfer_same_account: Both legs sit on the same account.
errors.transfer_same_direction: Both legs go the same way: a transfer has one outflow and one inflow.
errors.transfer_same_transaction: A transaction cannot be its own counterpart.
errors.transfer_already_complete: This transfer already has both legs.
errors.not_an_internal_transfer: This transaction is not categorized as an internal transfer.
